spans.s:
m. (-णः)
A defect, a fault.
mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Void of good qualities, bad.
2 Void of attributes.
E.
अ neg. गुण qualities.

(-ता)
Absence of all good qualities; also अगुणत्वं.
E.
अ neg. गुण with ता or त्व aff.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Censorious, pointing out defects.
E.
अगुण and वादिन् declaring.

mn. (-रुः-रु)
1 A fragrant wood, aloe wood, or agallochum, (Aquilaria agallocha, Rox.)
2 Another tree which produces Bdellium, (Amyris agallocha.)
3 A timber tree, commonly Sisū, (Dalbergia sisu, Rox.)
mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रू or-र्व्वी-रु)
Light, not heavy.
E.
अ priv. and गुरु heavy.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Unhidden, unconcealed.
2 One who cannot keep a secret.
E.
अ neg. गुप्त concealed.

f. (-पा)
A timber tree, (Dalbergia sisu.) The best authorities consider this as formed of two distinct words. See अगुरु and शिंशपा.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Unhidden, unconcealed, manifest, evident.
2 One who is not secret.
E.
अ neg. गूढ hidden.

n. (-न्धं)
Asafoetida.
E.
अगूढ and गन्ध smell.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Open, honest, candid; one whose purpose or inclinations are evident.
E.
अगूढ and भाव nature.

Very heavy.
E.
अगुरु and अण् aff.

f. (-गूः)
1 An agreement.
E.
आगम to come, डू affix, or आङ् prefixed to गू to come and क्विन् affix; also आगुर्.
